captures.subject: 61 FR 25228 (1996-05-20) Docket 96N-0151 - withdrawal of NDA 18-103 Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets
captures.finding: Federal Register Volume 61, Number 98 (Monday, May 20, 1996), pages 25228-25229, FR Doc 96-12570. FDA withdraws approval of NDA 18-103 for Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets held by SmithKline Beecham Pharmaceuticals. SmithKline requested withdrawal because the product is no longer being marketed and waived its opportunity for a hearing. Supplementary information: by letter dated June 30, 1994, SmithKline requested that FDA withdraw NDA 18-103, stating that the company discontinued marketing the product in 1980 because of liver toxicity observed after approval of the NDA. Effective date May 20, 1996. The notice does NOT state the original approval date, class, or review priority.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: [Federal Register Volume 61, Number 98 (Monday, May 20, 1996)] [Notices] [Pages 25228-25229] From the Federal Register Online via the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov] [FR Doc No: 96-12570] DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES [Docket No. 96N-0151] SmithKline Beecham Pharmaceuticals; Withdrawal of Approval of a New Drug Application for Selacryn Tablets AGENCY: Food and Drug Administration, HHS. ACTION: Notice. SUMMARY: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is withdrawing approval of a new drug application (NDA) for Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets held by SmithKline Beecham Pharmaceuticals (Smithkline). SmithKline requested that the NDA be withdrawn because the product is no longer being marketed. SmithKline also waived its opportunity for a hearing. EFFECTIVE DATE: May 20, 1996. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: By letter dated June 30, 1994, SmithKline, Four Falls Corp. Center, Route 23 and Woodmont Ave., P.O. Box 1510, FF0410, King of Prussia, PA 19406, requested that FDA withdraw NDA 18-103 for Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets, stating that the company discontinued marketing the product in 1980 because of liver toxicity observed after approval of the NDA. SmithKline waived its opportunity for a hearing. Therefore, under section 505(e) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355(e)) and under authority delegated to the Director, Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (21 CFR 5.82), approval of NDA 18-103, and all amendments and supplements thereto, is hereby withdrawn effective May 20, 1996. Dated: May 6, 1996. Murray M. Lumpkin, Deputy Director, Center for Drug Evaluation and Research.
captures.project_effect: names NDA 18-103 Selacryn (ticrynafen) as a 1979 gap candidate; does not supply an ORIG date/class/priority, so the candidate is recorded as NAMED_CANDIDATE_NOT_ADDED and is never written to pre1980_fda_decisions.csv
